phases.name: Core Loop Module and PR State Polling

tasks.description: Create shared/egg_babysit/ package structure with config, types, and __init__
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Package importable; BabysitConfig and PRState dataclasses defined with all fields

tasks.description: Implement PR state poller using gh CLI for PR metadata, CI checks, and merge status
tasks.acceptance_criteria: PRState correctly parses gh pr view --json and gh pr checks --json output; handles API errors

tasks.description: Implement main babysit loop skeleton with step transitions and exit conditions
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Loop runs, detects PR merged and exits; respects timeout and max-iterations; emits progress

tasks.description: Implement CI check waiter with configurable poll interval and status streaming
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Waiter polls CI, detects pass/fail/pending, returns structured result with failed job details

tasks.description: Add unit tests for PR state parsing, loop transitions, and CI waiter
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All unit tests pass; covers state parsing, loop exit conditions, CI status detection

tasks.description: Implement Python wrappers for bash prompt builders (check-fixer and review prompts)
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Wrappers call bash scripts via subprocess and return valid prompt strings; load check-fixers.yml

tasks.description: Implement fixer agent spawner with container lifecycle and commit SHA capture
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Fixer container spawns with correct prompt, captures commit SHA, handles failures with retry

tasks.description: Implement reviewer agent spawner in read-only mode with review verdict capture
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Reviewer spawns read-only, posts GitHub review, returns verdict (approve/request-changes/comment)

tasks.description: Implement conflict resolution step with detection and fixer invocation
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Detects mergeable_state dirty, spawns fixer, verifies resolution, escalates if unresolvable

tasks.description: Implement check fixer step with non-LLM-first strategy and retry tracking
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Tries non-LLM fix per check-fixers.yml, falls back to LLM, tracks retries via markers, escalates after max

tasks.description: Implement review and feedback addressing steps with round capping
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Reviewer posts review after CI passes; fixer addresses requested changes; caps at max rounds

tasks.description: Add integration tests for agent spawning, prompt building, and retry logic
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Tests pass with mocked container spawner; cover prompt output, retry counting, escalation

phases.name: Orchestrator Pipeline Mode and CLI Command

tasks.description: Extend Pipeline model with mode field (issue/babysit) and pr_number; support pr-N pipeline IDs
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Pipeline model accepts mode and pr_number; state store serializes/deserializes correctly

tasks.description: Add babysit pipeline lifecycle to orchestrator routes (create, start, status)
tasks.acceptance_criteria: POST /api/v1/pipelines with mode=babysit creates pr-N pipeline; start triggers loop; status shows loop state

tasks.description: Build CLI command (egg babysit-pr) with argument parsing and orchestrator registration
tasks.acceptance_criteria: egg babysit-pr <PR> creates pipeline, starts loop, streams status; --help shows options

tasks.description: Implement HITL escalation with decision queue and GitHub comment notification
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Unrecoverable state creates HITL decision; PR comment posted explaining blocker; loop pauses until resolved

tasks.description: Implement graceful shutdown (SIGTERM/SIGINT) and crash recovery from saved pipeline state
tasks.acceptance_criteria: SIGTERM saves state; restart resumes from saved iteration/step; no duplicate agent sessions

tasks.description: Add end-to-end tests for CLI, pipeline lifecycle, HITL escalation, and shutdown/resume
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Tests pass covering full CLI invocation, pipeline CRUD, escalation flow, and resume

tasks.description: Write integration test validating gateway allows push to PR branches for bot/trusted-user PRs
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Test confirms push allowed for bot-authored PR; push allowed for trusted-user PR; push denied for untrusted

tasks.description: Implement concurrent push detection (head SHA change) and rate limit backoff
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Detects unexpected head SHA change and re-fetches state; backs off when rate limit headers indicate throttling

tasks.description: Add module docstrings, type hints, and README with usage examples
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All public functions have docstrings and type hints; README covers usage, config, and architecture

tasks.description: Update shared/pyproject.toml with egg_babysit package and console_scripts entry point
tasks.acceptance_criteria: pip install -e shared/ registers egg-babysit-pr command; package discoverable

decisions.question: babysit-pr Execution Model: Should babysit-pr use the orchestrator for lifecycle management, or run as a standalone process?

options.label: Orchestrator-backed — Checkpoints, container lifecycle, health monitoring built in; slower startup
Standalone — Faster, simpler loop; no checkpoints or orchestrator observability
Both — Orchestrator by default, --standalone flag for lightweight mode
Other (explain in reply)

decisions.question: Prompt Builder Strategy: How should the Python babysit-pr module consume the existing bash prompt builders (action/build-*.sh)?

options.label: Call existing bash scripts via subprocess — Minimal change, single source of truth
Port to Python modules — Cleaner integration, duplicates logic until Actions updated
Thin Python wrappers that call bash scripts — Python API, bash implementation underneath
Other (explain in reply)

decisions.question: PR Branch Handling: When agents manage a PR-seeded pipeline, should they push to the PR's existing head branch or create a new branch?

options.label: Push to existing PR head branch — Simpler, risks conflicts with PR author
Create new branch and update PR head — Safer isolation, changes PR branch
Use existing branch, expect no concurrent pushes — Simple, relies on coordination
Other (explain in reply)

decisions.question: babysit-pr Scope — Conflict Resolution: Should v1 include merge conflict resolution, or defer to v2?

options.label: Yes, include conflict resolution — Full loop as described in issue
No, defer to v2 — Simpler v1: CI wait → check fix → review → feedback only
Other (explain in reply)

decisions.question: Terminal UX: What level of terminal output is expected for the babysit-pr CLI in v1?

options.label: Minimal — Periodic status line updates (poll and print)
Medium — Rich terminal output with progress bars and color
Full — Live-streaming agent output to terminal
Other (explain in reply)

decisions.question: Review-Only vs Review-and-Fix: Should babysit-pr always pair review with auto-fix, or support a review-only mode?

options.label: Always fix — Review always followed by auto-fix attempt
Optional review-only — --review-only flag to post review and stop
Both by default — Auto-fix with --no-fix flag to opt out
Other (explain in reply)

decisions.question: Non-Trusted-User PR Handling: How should babysit-pr handle PRs authored by someone not in GATEWAY_TRUSTED_USERS?

options.label: Require trusted user — Only babysit PRs from trusted users or bot-authored PRs
Add bot as co-author — Bot opens its own PR to same branch
Gateway policy extension — New babysit permission mode for explicit requests
Other (explain in reply)

decisions.question: Dependency Sequencing: Should babysit-pr ship independently before the coordinator (#1028), or wait?

options.label: Ship babysit-pr standalone first — Deliver value immediately, integrate with coordinator later
Wait for coordinator — Implement both together to avoid rework
babysit-pr standalone + PR-seeded as coordinator milestone — Two separate deliverables
Other (explain in reply)
